## Heyo!
[![Discord - @davide_24](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-%40davide__24-7289da?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](discord://-/users/482217763855925248)
[![Email me - contact@davicloud.net](https://img.shields.io/badge/Email_me-contact%40davicloud.net-white?style=for-the-badge&logo=gmail&logoColor=white)](mailto:contact@davicloud.net)
[![Website - www.davicloud.net](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-www.davicloud.net-white?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.davicloud.net)
[![GitHub - Davicloud-NET](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Davicloud--NET-white?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Davicloud-NET)

I'm David, also known as D244 or D24. I do a bunch of programming, these days under the name [Davicloud](https://davicloud.net), out of Salzburg, Austria.

I mainly develop Windows apps, but not only for Windows anymore: Avalonia and Uno Platform now sit next to WinUI 3. A good chunk of what I write is web stuff on ASP.NET Core, which I host myself. I also set up and look after servers and networks for companies.

Most of it still lives in private repositories, but the big one is public now.

I know a few programming languages. Those include:
- C
- C++
- C#
- JavaScript
- TypeScript
- Luau

And I can also design some decent UI in XAML :)

## What I'm working on

<table>
<tr>
<td width="88" align="center"><a href="https://github.com/Davicloud-NET/DDT"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Davicloud-NET/DDT/master/src/DDT.Design/brand/ddt-logo.png" width="64" alt="DDT logo"></a></td>
<td>

**[DDT](https://github.com/Davicloud-NET/DDT)**, the Davicloud Deployment Toolkit. A modern on-prem netboot OS deployment toolkit, meant to replace the deprecated MDT. Plug a PC into the network, let it netboot, and it comes out the other end with Windows or Linux on it. Made for networks of 10 to 100 machines, and the biggest thing I've built so far.

[![Latest DDT release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Davicloud-NET/DDT?include_prereleases&style=for-the-badge&label=Pre-release&labelColor=8b0f22&color=5f5f5f)](https://github.com/Davicloud-NET/DDT/releases)
[![License - GPL-3.0-or-later](https://img.shields.io/badge/GPL--3.0--or--later-whatever.svg?style=for-the-badge&label=License&labelColor=8b0f22&color=5f5f5f)](https://github.com/Davicloud-NET/DDT/blob/master/LICENSE)

</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="88" align="center"><a href="https://github.com/Davicloud-NET/Spectra"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Davicloud-NET/Spectra/HEAD/Assets/Logo/LogoSpectra.png" width="64" alt="Spectra logo"></a></td>
<td>

**[Spectra](https://github.com/Davicloud-NET/Spectra)**, a game and rendering engine written in C# with Silk.NET and Native AOT. The goal is an engine that's easy to pick up and still powerful, with design ideas from the Source and Roblox engines.

</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="88" align="center"><a href="https://github.com/Davide244/Clankboard"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Davide244/Clankboard/HEAD/Art/logo.svg" width="64" alt="Clankboard logo"></a></td>
<td>

**[Clankboard](https://github.com/Davide244/Clankboard)**, a soundboard app for Windows, made with C# and WinUI 3.

</td>
</tr>
</table>

Not out yet: **DCLAS**, the Davicloud CLA System, which will collect contributor licence agreements on pull requests.

The Davicloud projects live over at [Davicloud-NET](https://github.com/Davicloud-NET). Smaller and older things are still here on this profile, and there is [FödiBär](https://davicloud.net/software/f%C3%B6dib%C3%A4r), a little browser extension I made on the side. Found a bug in one of the projects? Its issue tracker is the best place for it.
